title: Print Multiple Lines
description:
Write a program that prints three lines:
Line 1: `Welcome to VidyaQuest`
Line 2: `Code Citadel`
Line 3: `Level 1`
instructions: Print each phrase on its own separate line.
You can use three print statements or newline characters (\n).

examples.output:
Welcome to VidyaQuest
Code Citadel
Level 1

hints: Each print() / console.log() / System.out.println() call automatically adds a newline.
Call the print function three times in order.

publicTestCases.expectedOutput:
Welcome to VidyaQuest
Code Citadel
Level 1

hiddenTestCases.expectedOutput:
